note: Fresh spot-verification pass. Status meanings: verified = confirmed in official text retrieved this session; verified-limited = confirmed with a stated limit; unverified-blank = value left blank because it cannot be confirmed from an official source retrieved this session. No personal facts inferred; no personal tax bill computed.

findings.claim: Overseas individuals' lawful current-account CNY income in China is converted at a bank with valid ID and source/transaction evidence including tax vouchers.
findings.locator: SAFE Tianjin 2026-07-13 Q&A, citing Huifa [2020] No. 14 Art. 59
findings.detail: The bank, not the taxpayer alone, applies the FX category. Documentation is the gate; no separate conversion tax is stated in this guidance.

findings.claim: U.S. tax items received/paid in foreign currency must be translated into functional currency (generally USD) at the prevailing rate.
findings.locator: IRS 'Foreign currency and currency exchange rates', functional-currency section
findings.detail: Supports the E01 limitation: 'no tax on converting' must not be read as 'no taxable income or currency gain'. Basis and history remain unknown.

findings.claim: IRS yearly average for China Yuan in 2025 is 7.129 CNY/USD; the IRS has no official exchange rate and generally accepts a consistently used posted/spot rate.
findings.locator: IRS yearly-average table, China row (2025 column); 'IRS has no official exchange rate' note
findings.detail: 7.129 is a reference conversion only. It is not a bank's executable CNY/USD rate and must not be presented as today's conversion quote (flag G03).

findings.claim: FBAR civil penalty maximums for penalties assessed on/after 2025-01-17: non-willful $16,536; willful $165,353.
findings.locator: 31 CFR 1010.821 Table 1, rows for 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) and (a)(5)(C)(i)(I)
findings.detail: Maximums only. Whether any penalty applies depends on filing history, willfulness and account facts, which are unknown. eCFR is authoritative but unofficial.

findings.claim: HSBC China outward telegraphic transfer (Premier/Advance): 0.1% of amount, min CNY 100, max CNY 500, plus CNY 120 per cable; Private Banking individuals free.
findings.detail: Recomputed this session at 7.129: $10,000 -> CNY 220 fee ($30.86); $400,000 -> CNY 620 fee ($86.97). Fee caps at CNY 500 + CNY 120 cable once 0.1% exceeds CNY 500 (about $70,150). Pay Exact adds CNY 200 (item 2.2.4.1 remark).

findings.claim: HSBC Global Transfer to own overseas HSBC account: free for Private Banking and Premier; Advance CNY 145 indicative (USD 20). The USD 7 item is International Education Payment, not a general remittance fee.
findings.locator: Tariff items 2.2.6.1 (Global Transfer), 2.2.6.2 (Global Transfer to Family), 2.2.7 (Education Payment)
findings.detail: Confirms prior-session correction C04. Any page still showing 'Global Transfer USD 0-7' as a general fee is outdated (see ladder flagged page).

findings.claim: HSBC tariff charges exclude charges of other institutions (correspondent/intermediary banks, other HSBC Group members, taxes/levies). The tariff does not publish an FX spread.
findings.locator: Tariff Important Note 7; no spread item in items 2.2.4-2.2.7
findings.detail: Published wire fees are therefore not all-in delivery costs. Modelled spread bands (e.g. 0.30-1.50%) remain unverified assumptions (flag G03).

findings.claim: Personal foreign-currency gain over $200 is a capital gain (IRS Pub. 525).
findings.locator: Pub. 525 (2025) — table of contents retrieved this session; $200 text not re-read
findings.detail: Figure carried from prior sessions (briefing layer 4). Left unverified in this fresh pass; see flag G01. Do not cite this session as fresh confirmation of the $200 figure.

findings.claim: Best lawful route and exact tax due for this user's China balance.
findings.detail: Source of funds, residency, account type, tax history and prior filings are unknown. Value intentionally blank. See Flagged for Review.

findings.claim: Current executable all-in CNY-to-USD cost (rate + spread + all fees) for any amount $10,000-$400,000.
findings.detail: No bank quote was obtained and no funds moved. Published HSBC fees above are tariff items only. All-in cost intentionally blank; see Flagged for Review.
